context: Hi! I'm here to recommend a move trailer for you. Do you know what kind of move trailer you might be interested in?
A suspensfull movie
I recently watched a movie called Knives out, where an eccentric and wealthy author is murdered and his family members are all suspects. Would you be into that?
Yes that sounds very interesting. Did it have a lot of twists and turns?
It's the type of movie where you won't see the end coming. Do you like Daniel Craig or Chris Evans?
Yes. Love those kinds of movies. I am not so familiar with the cast you mention. But I think you have made an excellent recommendation. Thank you!
So would like to watch this movie trailer?
Yes I would. I accept.
Awesome, hope you end up liking it. Take care!
You must tell me your best part of the movie.
It's definitely Daniel Craig's performance.
What other movies has he played in?
Most people know him from 007. I was shocked to see him doing a southern accent in Knives Out.
Ohhh. I know who he is now... southern accent.. hmm interesting. Did you watch this at the Theater ?
I actually saw it at home. It would definitely be good to see at home or in theater's.
Is it streaming on Netflix?
Not yet. You can it on Amazon Prime for $3.99 and probably also through your cable provider.
You think its worth the cost then?
Definitely! It's one of my favorite movies this year.
I think you may have talked me into it then.
Great, have a great night! (I think the chat is actually done now)
